symbols.definition: Eligible recorded watch-page video views in stated reporting period
Applicable Shorts engaged views, not identical to raw view count
Creator revenue per 1,000 applicable views, after platform allocation, observed for a specific cohort and period
Creator revenue per 1,000 relevant Shorts engaged views in the selected reporting definition
Viewer-funded membership receipts before applicable platform cuts, taxes and deductions
Eligible net receipts before the applicable creator share, requires definition
Gross sponsorship receipts net of direct contractual and fulfillment costs
Affiliate commissions after refunds and associated direct costs
Net earnings from owned products or services after direct costs
Project fixed cash costs over reporting period
Per-video and variable production cash costs
Promotion expenditure attributable to reporting period
Non-production cash costs such as banking, subscriptions or tools
Writing, recording, editing, artwork and verification labor
Promotion, replies, cross-posting and audience work
Other operational labor including support and bookkeeping

calculations.note: Only valid if RPM scope precisely matches views, format, period and geography. Do not apply 55% again to after-share RPM.
Never use raw Shorts viewCount as engaged views by default; product definitions and eligibility vary.
Contractual creator share for applicable eligible Commerce Product Module receipts; not 70% of gross payment.

calculations.expression: watch_ad_estimate + shorts_ad_estimate + membership_creator_share + sponsorship_net + affiliate_net + product_net
calculations.note: All streams must be net on compatible bases. Null inputs mean unavailable, not zero.
Before explicitly accounted taxes and any unmeasured obligations; not take-home earnings automatically.
Capture hours spent on unsuccessful drafts and promotion as well.
Undefined when labor is zero or unknown; not a guaranteed hourly wage.

assumption_constraints: All monetary symbols must use the same currency and observation period or provide an explicit conversion method.
Never represent creator revenue as advertiser CPM times gross public views.
The contractual 55%, 45% and 70% figures have different denominators and must not be added or used interchangeably.
A zero for unknown volume, income or time is not an acceptable default.
Separate historical, observed and scenario revenue from inferred or simulated results.
Include labor and failure costs when comparing niches or publishing strategies.
Do not claim which content niche earns more without comparable representative evidence.
